value.rationale: The recent source motivates understanding finite signal propagation and alignment in higher-dimensional multiagent systems. The geometric competition between growing signal travel time and weakening coupling produces a structurally natural, exact real–complex–real leading-spectrum transition in physical separation, with a sharp speed boundary and unbounded growth of the intervening region as N grows. These are meaningful predicted relaxation-mode boundaries rather than arbitrary finite numerical slices or a mere sign-of-eigenvalue test.
